Wow! I really liked the game and I have some ideas for it. At the start, put a 'Welcome to Fatal Apes!' message and play the song "Tophats N’ Tools - Solar.mp3 (ChimpLab VR OST)". Also, you can add new monsters — "BigGuy", "Ape-1", "Kus", "???", "Meat", "Billy", "Sandguy", "John", and "Lurker". Could you please make it so the music in the lobby is from the original Lethal Ape game? Add more cosmetics to the shop too. And at the end of the map, add some kind of continuation — for example, a new area like a maze with blue and white rooms, or something else. Could you also please add a monster room and add a quest cam to the game? Could you please add cameras to the game? Could you please add a second floor near the lobby, like in Lethal Ape 3? And one last thing: could you add a pool on the first floor? I hope your game becomes the best! Please add this stuff. Thanks!
